findings.impact: Locale-dependent decoding and file text IO corrupt or reject UTF8 protocol data.
findings.reproduction: Real child emitting Japanese UTF8 fails UnicodeDecodeError with LC_ALL=C/PYTHONUTF8=0/PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0 before fix.
findings.resolution: Pin UTF8 at current production text=True subprocess and Path text IO boundaries; binary APIs unchanged.

findings.impact: Permission failure inspecting stop marker grants benign tool calls.
findings.reproduction: Real uid1000 process with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR chmod000 returned Copilot permissionDecision allow before fix.
evidence: Python actual unprivileged Linux process, no mocked permission error; macOS/Windows unexecuted
findings.resolution: Use explicit stat and preserve regular-file meaning; ENOENT/ENOTDIR absent, other OSError emits distinct inspection-error deny.
